errors.evidence: The y-axis label is 'ROUGE-2', but the description states the chart shows 'ROUGE-1' scores. This may be due to a conflict with the paper's caption, but the description should reflect the visual contents of the figure itself.

errors.evidence: The relationship between ROUGE-2 score and data amount is not linear; the slope of the line changes several times. Stating it is a linear relationship is an incorrect interpretation, not an objective description.
The numerical labels on the x-axis are placed at an interval of 5000 (e.g., 5000, 10000, 15000), not 10000.
The description incorrectly uses the range of the data values to describe the y-axis range. The labeled y-axis range shown is from 38 to 48.
The y-axis label, which acts as the unit in this context, is 'ROUGE-2', not 'ROUGE-1'.
At a data amount of 10000, the value shown on the chart is 46.87, not 42.33.
At a data amount of 20000, the value shown on the chart is 47.52, not 46.87.
At a data amount of 30000, the value shown on the chart is 47.48, not 47.52.
At a data amount of 40000, the final data point has a value of 49.16, not 47.96.
